description: Operate Tencent Cloud Elasticsearch Service (ES) via MCP: list instances, inspect cluster health/nodes/shards/thread pools, browse index settings and mappings, query monitoring metrics and cluster logs, diagnose performance and unassigned shards, and manage clusters (scale nodes/disk, restart, rollover, aliases, Kibana access, Logstash pipelines).

display.description_en: Operate Tencent Cloud Elasticsearch Service (ES) via MCP: list instances, inspect cluster health/nodes/shards/thread pools, browse index settings and mappings, query monitoring metrics and cluster logs, diagnose performance and unassigned shards, and manage clusters (scale nodes/disk, restart, rollover, aliases, Kibana access, Logstash pipelines).
display.description_zh: 通过 MCP 操作腾讯云 Elasticsearch Service（ES）：查询实例列表，查看集群健康、节点、分片与线程池状态，浏览索引配置与 Mapping，查询监控指标与集群日志，诊断集群性能与分片未分配问题，并管理集群（节点/磁盘变配、重启、索引 Rollover、别名、Kibana 访问、Logstash 管道）。
examples_en: List the Elasticsearch instances in ap-guangzhou
Check the cluster health of es-xxxxxxxx and whether there are unassigned shards
Show CPU, JVM memory and disk usage metrics of es-xxxxxxxx for the last hour
Diagnose why indexing on es-xxxxxxxx is slow, check thread pools and hot threads
List the largest indices on es-xxxxxxxx and show their mappings and settings
Scale the data nodes of es-xxxxxxxx up to 6
examples_zh: 帮我查一下 ap-guangzhou 地域下有哪些 ES 集群实例
看看 es-xxxxxxxx 集群的健康状态，有没有未分配的分片
查一下 es-xxxxxxxx 最近一小时的 CPU、JVM 内存和磁盘使用率监控数据
帮我分析 es-xxxxxxxx 集群写入变慢的原因，看下线程池和热点线程
列出 es-xxxxxxxx 中占用磁盘最大的索引，并查看它的 Mapping 和 Settings
帮我给 es-xxxxxxxx 集群扩容数据节点数量到 6 个
display.name: 腾讯云 Elasticsearch Service

name: es
